So today we worked on stock gift card inventory. We started with the white gloss sticker paper and printed out our ocean pack and our space pack through the print and cut feature on Cricut Design Space.

We opened up our Cricut and set up the blade pressure in the settings to the more option. We also calibrated our blade to ensure accurate cuts. We used our light grip mat and prepared our sticker sheet for cutting. The Cricut first scanned the sheet to understand where the sticker borders are, and then it started cutting.

We increased the blade pressure to make sure the blade would cut all the way through the entire piece of paper. It actually looked super cool and had very accurate cuts. We then peeled the excess sticker sheet off the mat and then took each sticker off one by one. The tools were pretty helpful but not necessary for this.

We used pieces of cardstock to make sure the stickers don't bend and put all of the stickers into our little plastic baggies. To seal our bags, we covered the end of the bag with aluminum to prevent the plastic from melting and used a hair straightener to heat seal the bags. We then set up the stickers for pictures.
